name: Gero Android Laboratory
backstory: Heavy firepower, protected endurance and mobile pressure give the laboratory three different answers to an arena contract. All three receive equipment before any luxury spending.
strategy_personality: A conspicuous missing franchise and an established three-character grouping. Android 16 is fully synthetic; 17 and 18 are human-based androids, so retain their authentic human appearance under the existing cyborg convention. Green armour and familiar clothing distinguish them. [Official android background](https://en.dragon-ball-official.com/news/01_531.html).
